pages.text: $(bold)Watcher's Will$() (built into void metal armour, $(bold)levelled$(), $(bold)stacks across pieces$())$(br2)Per level:$(li)$(bold)10%$() chance to dodge an incoming attack (sums the levels on all worn armour pieces, capped at 100%)$(li)$(bold)+15%$() casting speed for both $(bold)Goety$() and $(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$()$(br2)Note: Goety has no public casting-speed attribute, so this trait hooks its own $(bold)ModAttributes#getCastingSpeed$() (covers every Goety spell).$(br2)$(italic)The greatest feat, engraved upon the End!$()
